role: independent verification; built, repaired and rastered none of these families
grantsNothing: A PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT here proves a packet is complete and independently measured. It approves no output, promotes no family, opens no commercial route and creates no fulfillment record. A FAIL is a verdict and a repair assignment, never an edit.

Another agent has since moved the tree to fable/r13.

howEverythingWasMeasured.obligationSet: All fifteen canonical proof obligations, by name, on all seven families, per lane contract L9. No family was scored over a subset.
howEverythingWasMeasured.counters: The nine counters come from a fresh run of `node scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family <familyId>` in this container, once per family, not from any builder self-report.
howEverythingWasMeasured.artifacts: Every PDF and text artifact named in each family's reports/rendered-artifacts.json and render-reports was rehashed with SHA-256 from the committed bytes and compared to the recorded hash and byte length.
howEverythingWasMeasured.pageOrder: Page counts were read from the PDF bytes with pdfinfo and compared to the declared pageCount and to the pageManifest length, and packetPage sequences were checked for monotonicity.
howEverythingWasMeasured.geometry: Word geometry was extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` and every word was checked against the page box, and every same-band word pair against every other, for overlap above 0.75pt. Totals: SC 2421 words, SD 2265, GA 2180, NV 5158, ME 2503, VA 3141, OH 1227. Zero out-of-box words and zero overlapping pairs across all fourteen fixtures.
howEverythingWasMeasured.sourceIdentity: `bash scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh` MOUNTED SUCCESSFULLY in this container. The archive SHA-256 verified as a26e3ca7d52db4460e53c2eddd893109037702f5c8035f2c698a7e16bad84e89 and the governance checksums verified across 51 jurisdictions, 499 files and 329 PDFs. feeAndServiceStandard.readFirst: data/rcap-grade-a/fable-packet-factory/DETERMINATION_FEE_AND_WAIVER_STANDARD.json, including Amendment A1, was read before FEE_AND_WAIVER or SERVICE was scored on any family.
feeAndServiceStandard.testApplied: Ask first whether the repository establishes the answer. If it does, the packet must state it. Only where no held source establishes it may a NAMED checkable authority stand in — an office, desk or clerk reachable in practice, never a gesture. True silence fails.
feeAndServiceStandard.whereTheRepositoryWasCheckedFirst: For each family I read data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json for that track before scoring, so that a named-authority pass was never awarded over an answer the repository already holds. That check changed nothing on these seven — every packet states what its registry entry holds — but it is the check A1 requires and it was made, not assumed.
feeAndServiceStandard.outcome: Seven of seven pass FEE_AND_WAIVER and seven of seven pass SERVICE, on three different branches of the standard: sourced no-fee statements (SC, ME, VA), a sourced amount with a waiver mechanism (OH, $50 with an indigency exception), and honest refusals naming a reachable authority (SD, NV, GA).
feeAndServiceStandard.briefCorrection: My brief said me-screening-set is discussed in the determination's `alsoRecorded` section. It is not — that section names me-nonconv-set, a different Maine family scored in VF11. I read the section regardless and applied its reasoning (NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE is reserved for what a lane's environment cannot measure, not for a does-not-apply call). Since nothing in these rows is scored NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE, the correction changes no verdict. Recorded because the brief and the determination disagree on the family name and a later lane should not go looking for a paragraph that is not there.

families.theSecondReadItWasOwed: It got one. I read what is in the tree now rather than what the earlier verdicts said, and the two readings diverge in both directions. The earlier repair is REAL and I confirmed it independently: commit da596ed81 fixed the render-report text hashes VF02 failed, and all four bound files — canonical.pdf, boundary.pdf, canonical.txt, boundary.txt — now rehash to exactly what their render-reports record. ARTIFACTS therefore PASSES here on my own measurement and VF02's failure is closed on evidence rather than on assertion. What the repair did not touch is the completeness contract, and that defect is still present.
families.whyItStillFails: The family publishes no production-field-map.json; product-wiring.json says so itself with fieldMap null. The completeness verifier returns FAIL_COMPONENT_SET with auditable false and 0/0 fields written — it refuses the family before counting anything. Three further contract files are absent: reports/actual-writes.json, reports/completeness-counters.json, reports/blanks-left-for-the-participant.json. Reading the delivered bytes directly makes it worse rather than better: the pleading prints builder instructions in its body where facts belong — '[ARRESTING AGENCY MUST BE CONFIRMED]', '[ARREST DATE TO BE CONFIRMED]', '[DISPOSITION DATE TO BE CONFIRMED]' — and paragraph 9 promises a list of every charge arising from the same act under § 2953.61 with nowhere on the document to list them.
families.importantAboutTheCounters: The nine counters printed as zeros for this family and those zeros are NOT evidence of completeness. The run refused the family before counting. The row records this explicitly so no downstream reader treats the zeros as a clean sweep.

ARTIFACTS, PAGE_ORDER, CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP, PROTECTED_FIELDS, ROUTE_IDENTITY, ROUTE_OPTIONS, REPEATING_ROWS, FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER, SERVICE and SELF_HELP_STOP all pass. boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.question: Must the named checkable authority appear in the SAME statement as the refusal, or is it enough that the packet names one somewhere the participant will reach?
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.whatTheGaPacketDoes: Its MONEY paragraph states the refusal cleanly — 'No fee is identified for this request anywhere in the records this packet is built from' — but names nobody in that sentence. Two paragraphs above, STEP THREE directs the participant to contact the booking facility and ask where the request should be sent and whether the facility publishes its own form. The facility is specific, reachable, and a step the participant must take anyway.
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.howIScoredIt: PASS. The determination's language is 'the packet states ... AND names a specific checkable authority', addressed to the packet rather than to the sentence, and the participant can in fact find out what filing costs, which the determination says is the point. This is not the 'check with the court' gesture the determination refuses.
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.whyIAmFlaggingItAnyway: The determination's own proven case (the DC families) had the authority named in the same breath as the refusal, with a phone number. GA is a step weaker than that. This is the same class of divergence that produced the determination in the first place — two verifiers scoring the same words differently — one level down again, so it is raised rather than resolved quietly in this lane.
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.changesNoVerdictIfSettledEitherWay: If the Captain rules that the authority must sit in the same statement, ga-jail-k2-set's FEE_AND_WAIVER becomes a FAIL and its verdict becomes FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED with a one-sentence repair. Nothing else in these three lanes turns on the answer: SC, ME and VA state sourced fee rules, and SD, NV and OH name their authority in the same sentence as the refusal or state an amount.

boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.question: Where a family's fee statement lives only in participant-instructions.md and appears nowhere on the rendered PDF, has the participant been told?
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.whatTheOhPacketDoes: participant-instructions.md records the $50 filing fee, the indigency exception and the authority to confirm both with. None of that appears on any of the three rendered pages.
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.howIScoredIt: PASS, on the family's participant-facing instructions record, which is where every family in these lanes carries its fee statement. But in the six field-map families the instructions are ALSO bound into the packet PDF as a component; in Ohio they are not.
boundariesRaisedForTheCaptain.whyItMatters: It is not decisive for Ohio, which fails anyway on COMPONENT_SET, and the packaging fix belongs with that repair. It would be decisive for a family that otherwise passed, so it is worth settling before one appears.

whatICouldNotMeasure.nothingOnTheFifteen: Every one of the fifteen obligations was measured on all seven families. No obligation on any row is scored NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE, because the Master Library mounted and every artifact needed was present or accounted for.
whatICouldNotMeasure.rasterArtifactBlobs: The raster receipts cite their workflow artifact zips by id and SHA-256 rather than embedding them; this container cannot fetch GitHub artifact blobs, so I verified each receipt by recomputing its hash binding against the packet bytes rather than by downloading the zip. That is the binding the receipt exists to make, and it holds on all six rastered families.
whatICouldNotMeasure.theExcludedCorpusBinary: oh_marijuana_expungement-set declares a companion PDF that is absent from the tree under the recorded corpus-binary exclusion (commit c01b87d15). I did not treat that as an artifact-integrity failure, because its bytes rehash from the mounted library to the recorded hash at the recorded length. I recorded it under COMPONENT_SET instead, where the declared-set-versus-present-files mismatch actually belongs.
whatICouldNotMeasure.visualGate: Nothing here is a substitute for the central visual gate. My CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP measurement is text geometry over the delivered bytes; oh_marijuana_expungement-set is not in RASTER_QUEUE.json at all and has no central raster receipt of any kind.

rowsWritten.preservation: Every pre-existing row was preserved byte-for-byte in content and order; rows were appended, and the append refuses on a duplicate itemId. Each row carries verifiedAtBase ebc44031ec7eab29058bfc79a7bc5e1cff089414 on the row itself, not only at document level.

summary: Seven families verified against all fifteen canonical proof obligations with the Master Library mounted. Six pass complete and independent. One — oh_marijuana_expungement-set — fails again on a genuine second read, for different reasons than it failed before: its earlier ARTIFACTS repair is sound and confirmed, but it still publishes no completeness contract, and twelve of its fifteen obligations hold behind that one gap. No packet was edited, no route was opened, no family was promoted.
